2610.09876.title: Think Before You Paint: Recursive Latent Reasoning for Diffusion Models
2610.09876.paper_summary: Diffusion models generate realistic images but often fail on visual reasoning tasks, such as filling in a Sudoku or drawing the path through a maze. When a discrete symbolic representation is available, recursive methods such as the Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) solve even hard instances of these puzzles. We ask how such reasoning can be carried over to pixels, where no symbolic representation is available. We propose Painter-Thinker (PaTh): a small recursive network (the Thinker) reasons over a grid of learned tokens that encode the noisy image and the conditioning, refines a latent state within every denoising step, and steers a frozen diffusion model (the Painter) through ControlNet adapters. The Thinker is trained with the standard reconstruction loss alone, without symbolic targets, a solver, or a verifier. PaTh solves 92.5% of hard MNIST Sudoku puzzles (prior best 75%) and 71.2% of extreme ones (prior best 4.1%), with 10M parameters against 82M for a standard diffusion model. It also improves on mazes, Queens, and CLEVR scenes with specified spatial relations, and its advantage grows with problem size. Diagnostic experiments show that PaTh recovers from injected mistakes that the diffusion model cannot repair, especially when many cells are wrong. Together, these results show that reasoning mechanisms developed for symbolic data can be integrated into pixel-space diffusion without symbolic supervision, opening a path toward generating data under increasingly complex constraints.
2610.09876.paper_summary_zh: 擴散模型能生成逼真的圖像，但在視覺推理任務上常常失敗，例如填寫數獨或繪製迷宮中的路徑。當可用離散符號表示時，遞歸方法如小型遞歸模型（Tiny Recursive Model, TRM）能解決這些難題的困難實例。我們詢問如何將這種推理轉移到像素上，因為在那裡沒有符號表示。我們提出了畫家-思考者（Painter-Thinker, PaTh）：一個小型遞歸網絡（思考者）在學習的標記網格上進行推理，這些標記編碼了嘈雜的圖像和條件，在每個去噪步驟中細化潛在狀態，並通過ControlNet適配器引導一個凍結的擴散模型（畫家）。思考者僅用標準重建損失進行訓練，沒有符號目標、解算器或驗證器。PaTh解決了92.5%的困難MNIST數獨謎題（之前的最佳為75%）和71.2%的極端謎題（之前的最佳為4.1%），其參數為1000萬，而標準擴散模型為8200萬。它還在迷宮、皇后問題和具有指定空間關係的CLEVR場景中有所改善，並且其優勢隨著問題規模的增大而增強。診斷實驗顯示，PaTh能從擴散模型無法修復的注入錯誤中恢復，尤其是在許多單元錯誤的情況下。總體而言，這些結果表明，為符號數據開發的推理機制可以在沒有符號監督的情況下集成到像素空間擴散中，為在日益複雜的約束條件下生成數據開辟了一條道路。
